name: town_stat_recompute
note: Copies a roster record to new_char, resets AC and regen only, adds the equipped items' bonuses, copies it back. Accumulates to-hit, damage bonus, resistances and effect chances on every call (seen on the JP disc too); harmless, since battle_derive_stats rebuilds them at battle start. docs/re/bugs.md 3.4.

name: town_item_bonuses
note: For each pack slot: regen from carried items, and for equipped ones town_item_bonus_one; then town_unarmed_bonus for an unarmed Ninja or Monk.

name: town_item_bonus_one
note: Adds one equipped item's bonuses to new_char without resetting: protection and slay masks, effect resistances (to 100), AC, to-hit, magic resistance (to 100), weapon dice, effect chances. A mis-aligned item: to-hit -1, AC +1, and the item is cursed.

name: town_unarmed_bonus
note: Unarmed Ninja/Monk: reach 4 above level 8, damage bonus + level/4 + 4 (at most 10) on both hands, and the class's hit effect chance +20.

name: battle_derive_stats
note: Battle start: rebuilds a member's derived block (+0x7e..+0xbf) from scratch in new_char (saves, 2d2 dice + Strength bonus, resistances and masks zeroed, then gear) and copies it back (write seen at 0x800a1b50). Callers 0x800a293c, 0x800d32dc.

name: battle_derive_saves
note: The five saving throws +0x7e..+0x82: level/5 + Luck/6, held to 1-14, then class bonuses through save_bonus. +0x81 (fourth) takes the Thief's +3; breath and chest traps save on it, level drain reads it backwards (bugs.md 3.3).

name: save_bonus
note: save_bonus(which, n): raises save `which` (0 = +0x7e ... 4 = +0x82) by n, stopping past 33.

name: talk_overlay_message
note: Called first by every talk handler; returns 1 while a message box (DAT_80079a3e > 0) is up, and the handler then does nothing that frame.
